moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When a circle is applied to the allied field of play.

Cannot be deactivated. Never misses. Lowers the target’s by stat ranks. Leaves the target paralyzed. Has a chance (%) of making the target flinch.

moves.name:
Thunderous Roar
Wild Charge
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition:
When this move is used. Never misses. The power of this move is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Turns the field of play’s terrain into Electric Terrain. Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by ranks.

passives.name: Johto’s Thundering Legend
passives.description: Powers up the moves and sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 20%. Reduces attack move and sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 25%. The more allied sync pairs with you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 15% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 50%, and the maximum damage reduction is 31%.) Raises the sync buff of the user’s team by ranks the first time its sync move is used each battle.
